post.description: A seat code creates an account on that seat or brings back the account it belongs to. Name and color are required for a new account. Any older secret of the account stops working. A used code answers `409 code_redeemed`.
post.summary: Exchange a code for a secret

put.description: Without `key`, the slot is emptied. `color` is hex text from `cosmetic_colors` in the catalog and only works for colorable cosmetics.
put.summary: Put on a cosmetic or empty a slot

post.description: Lights up the top of a stack and everyone on it earns `lighthouse`, the top also `lighthouse-light`.
post.summary: Light up a jelly on the stage, so it can be found

get.description: Works without an account. With a token, `joined` says whether this player takes part in the running LAN.
get.summary: Read which LAN runs and which comes next
Read the own open partner emotes, for example after a restart

patch.description: The invited jelly sends `accepted` or `declined`, the one who asked sends `cancelled`. Accepting further apart than `near_distance` gets `409 too_far`, and the invite stays open.
patch.summary: Accept, decline or cancel a partner emote

post.description: The other client learns about it from `partner_emote.updated` and answers with PATCH. `partner_ids` holds exactly one jelly for now. Jellies further apart than `near_distance` get `409 too_far`.
post.summary: Ask another jelly for a partner emote

get.description: Pass `next_cursor` of the last page as `cursor`. Without `next_cursor`, it was the last page.
get.summary: Read the players, one page at a time
Read the state of the player
Read the profile of a player

post.description: A poke that comes too early is no error, it earns `xp_gained: 0`.
Send this every few minutes. Without it, a jelly falls asleep once `presence_window` passed since the last action.
post.summary: Keep the jelly awake while the app runs, without XP
Start a stack where the jelly stands

post.description: A stack further away than `near_distance` answers `409 too_far`.
post.summary: Climb on top of a stack nearby

get.summary: Read all visible jellies and areas

get.description: Starts after `Last-Event-ID`, then `since`, otherwise at the newest event. Players can only go back 1000 events, further back they get `reset` and read their state again. `topics` is a comma-separated list of `events` and `moves`, without it both arrive. Messages of type `move` have no ID and carry a `Move`. Every new connection first gets the current move of each jelly. Above the limits of the LAN for open streams, the answer is `429 rate_limited`.

200.description: A stream where the data of each message is one event

delete.summary: Go back to the own place

post.description: The jelly walks back after `follow_seconds`, see `follow_until`. The server may end this by itself, so read `follow_player_id` instead of assuming it stays set.
`x` and `y` are percent of the stage. The jelly walks to the free spot closest to the point and back after `trip_seconds`. This ends following.
post.summary: Walk to a point and come back after a while

get.description: Works without an account and stays at this path for every API version, so old apps can always find out that they need an update.
get.summary: Read the API version and the oldest app that still works
